items.text: No complainant names on the public dashboard
No phone numbers (full or partial) on the public dashboard
No exact home or GPS location; area / depot level only
No complaint description text on the public dashboard
No staff names or bus numbers linked to unverified allegations
Groups with fewer than 3 complaints are suppressed
Depot staff see phone numbers masked (e.g. 90XXXXXX21)
